Done. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T3/solution.py`: loads the two input shards, casts exactly the 112 named projection matrices (`self_attn.{q,k,v,o}_proj.weight`, `mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj.weight` per layer, via an anchored regex) to bfloat16, leaves everything else (embeddings, `lm_head.weight`) as float32, runs the four required assertions before writing, then greedy-packs tensors into shards under a 256 MiB tensor-data budget (oversized tensors — the two 412 MB embedding/lm_head tensors — each get their own shard), and writes `model.safetensors.index.json` with the resulting `weight_map`.
- Ran it once with `.venv/bin/python out/T3/solution.py`: succeeded on the first attempt, produced 114 tensors across 10 shards (112 bfloat16, 2 float32), all under the per-shard byte budget.
- Wrote `out/T3/REPORT.md` with the self-report.
